title:
Unlocking the Potential of Spotify Advertising
 – Soda Spoon Marketing

facts.fact: The vendor's blog says Spotify has a staggering 400 million active listeners.
facts.quote: with a staggering 400 million active listeners

facts.fact: The page cites unnamed studies saying Spotify ads can enhance ad recall by 81%.
facts.quote: Studies have shown that Spotify ads can enhance ad recall by a staggering 81%

facts.fact: The page says sponsored playlists cost more than simple audio ads, though it gives no dollar figures.
facts.quote: while sponsored playlists might offer massive visibility, they come with a heftier price tag compared to simple audio ads

facts.fact: The page describes Ad Studio as Spotify's self-serve ads manager.
facts.quote: visit Spotify's self-serve ads manager, Ad Studio

facts.fact: The page says advertisers can target Spotify audio ads by age, gender, and location.
facts.quote: Advertisers can target their audio ads based on demographics such as age, gender, and location.

facts.fact: The page says Spotify's targeting options let advertisers tweak ad delivery by time of day and by zip code.
facts.quote: tweak everything from the time of day to which zip code your intended audience lives in

facts.fact: The page says Spotify offers Spotify Ad Analytics to measure campaigns and track conversions beyond its platform.
facts.quote: Spotify offers tools like Spotify Ad Analytics to measure campaigns and track conversions beyond its platform.
